name: Sara Balloo's Plea
summary: In her grief, Sara Balloo asks an Alliance champion to carry her handwritten appeal to King Magni Bronzebeard.

sections.title: A Widow's Appeal
sections.body: Grief keeps Sara from facing the High Seat, so she entrusts her words to an adventurer loyal to the Alliance. She asks King Magni to remember the private mourning and sacrifices of ordinary dwarven families who serve the kingdom.

faq.answer: Sara Balloo's Plea is a handwritten letter for King Magni Bronzebeard. Sara asks for his attention while she mourns in private.

faq.q: Why does Sara Balloo need someone else to deliver it?
faq.answer: Sara is overcome with grief and believes appearing before the King of Ironforge in that state would hinder her plea. So she trusts an Alliance champion to deliver it.
King Magni Bronzebeard receives Sara's letter at the High Seat of Ironforge.

faq.q: What does delivering the letter lead to?
faq.answer: Presenting the letter brings Sara Balloo's bereavement to King Magni's attention and begins a royal response honoring her fallen family.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you carry Sara's message to the High Seat so King Magni hears every mountaineer or citizen, even in grief.
As an Alliance champion, you carry Sara's petition before royalty. She trusts you because of your service to the Alliance.
